generator.prompt: Frame-by-frame hand-painted 2D game sprite of Violet, a slender young girl adventurer, side-view profile facing right. She wears a hooded gray robe with a darker waist sash, an ankle-length robe skirt with a slightly darker hem, and goes barefoot with simple ankle wraps. Pale skin, dark hair just visible under the hood, a clearly readable young face in profile with a visible eye, brow, nose and mouth. Realistic child body proportions, about 5.5 head-heights tall, matching the reference turnaround exactly in design, coloring and proportions. Rendered as a single cohesive hand-painted illustration with soft painterly brushwork and visible brush texture, in a muted earthy palette (grays, browns, warm skin tones), NOT a flat vector cutout, in the painted-storybook register of games like Hollow Knight or GRIS. Recovering from a hard landing, partway back up from a deep crouch toward standing: knees are straightening but still noticeably bent, hips rising back up but not yet at full height, both feet flat and planted on the ground. Torso is uprighting from its forward fold but still leans forward a little, head coming back up. Arms are coming back down from their forward-swung balance position toward her sides, elbows still slightly bent. A clear mid-recovery pose, between the deep impact crouch and standing upright. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped. She stands at a consistent scale and vertical position: the same distance from the top of her hood to the ground line as in the reference image(s). Transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the character, no scarf or neck wrap of any kind -- bare gray robe collar at the neck; a separate layer will add the scarf later.
